results.title: Tool-latency percentiles (200 series × 5,000 = 1,000,000 samples)
results.question: Sketches promise huge savings on percentiles. Where is the break-even, and where do they lie to you?

variants.name: A · ZSET of raw samples
variants.note: Keep everything, sort on read. Exact, queryable, and the most expensive option available.

extra.also gives you: the raw samples, for anything else you need later

variants.name: B · TIMESERIES COMPRESSED (integer ms)
variants.note: Purpose-built, exact, and the row most people skip straight past on their way to a sketch.

extra.percentiles: computed client-side from TS.RANGE, or via a rollup rule

variants.name: C · T-DIGEST, compression 100 (default)
variants.note: Fixed 9,864 B per series REGARDLESS of sample count. Cheap per sample only if you feed it enough.

extra.exact?: no — and it has no proven error bound

variants.name: D · T-DIGEST, compression 200
variants.note: Double the RAM, several times the accuracy. The defensible default for anything you alert on.

variants.name: E · T-DIGEST, compression 500
variants.note: Diminishing returns on clean data — but see variant G for where it earns its keep.

variants.name: F · T-DIGEST c=100, archived as DUMP blobs
variants.note: Cold rollups do not need to be live keys. DUMP persists only the merged centroids, not the input buffer.

extra.archive is: RESTORE-able back into a live digest on demand

variants.name: G · T-DIGEST c=100, BIMODAL (0.5% timeouts)
variants.note: Identical sketch, realistic agent data: a body of normal latencies plus calls that hit the 30 s timeout.

extra.why: p99 sits on the cliff between the body and the timeout spike, where the CDF is near-vertical

variants.caveat: different input data — compare its error to C, not its size

variants.name: H · BIMODAL, timeouts excluded + exact counter
variants.note: The fix: digest only completed calls, count timeouts exactly. Both answers get better, and the count is exact.

extra.note: error is now measured against the completed-call distribution, which is the one you can act on

variants.caveat: different input data — compare its error to G
